question: Should the focused Android skill-management patch be reconstructed on current main and re-proven for landing?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven at its reviewed head, but resolving extensive overlapping Android changes produces a materially new integration commit that needs a maintainer-owned reconstruction and proof decision.

options.title: Reconstruct and prove exact commit
options.body: Integrate only the focused feature on current main and rerun the security, reconnect, localization, and emulator evidence against the resulting SHA.

options.title: Pause integration
options.body: Keep the PR open without landing if maintainers do not want to own the conflict resolution and renewed proof now.

recommendation.title: Reconstruct and prove exact commit
recommendation.body: Integrate only the focused feature on current main and rerun the security, reconnect, localization, and emulator evidence against the resulting SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee, authored the rewritten commits, and supplied the exact-head land-ready verification.
